name: pukial
description: Pukial skills for Claude Code, one plugin across domains: deckwright turns an idea into a slide deck (binding spec, HTML drafts on a design system, native editable PPTX or printable HTML deck, QA loop); ship-check is the Flutter architecture gate (review -> triage -> fix -> recommend); new-app scaffolds a com.pukial Flutter app from flutter-pukial-starter; aso-appstore-screenshots produces conversion-focused App Store and Google Play screenshot decks.
